Class SshClientTheme

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientTheme
public class SshClientTheme extends Object
// @aa-sdd PK-999 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md The SshClientTheme is the dark Metal look for the SSH window and the Aetheris window. Metal is the Swing look and feel this class customizes. The colors come from SshClientProperties. A menu hover paints a grey tab. A canvas scroll pane uses the quiet bevel.
Author:
clayl (2026-08-24)

  • Field Details

    • DIVIDER_SIZE

      public static final int DIVIDER_SIZE
      The DIVIDER_SIZE constant is the split-bar thickness, in pixels. The value is eleven. applySplitPane(JSplitPane) uses it while one-touch expansion is on.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

  • Constructor Details

    • SshClientTheme

      public SshClientTheme(SshClientProperties properties)
      The constructor copies colors from the properties store. darkGround(Color, int, int) remaps a frame background that is still 0x1e1e1e to 0x0c0c0c. A panel background that is still 0x2d2d2d becomes 0x121212. A status background that is still 0x171717 becomes 0x0c0c0c. A split background that is still 0x1e1e1e becomes 0x0c0c0c. The panel foreground is stored as loaded. The field background and the field foreground are stored as loaded. The button background and the button foreground are stored as loaded. The status foreground is stored as loaded. The menu foreground is stored as loaded.
      Parameters:
      properties - The loaded client properties.

  • Method Details

    • installLookAndFeelDefaults

      public void installLookAndFeelDefaults()
      The installLookAndFeelDefaults method writes dark defaults into the Swing UI manager. Call it before the components are created. Panel.background and Label.background receive the panel background. Panel.foreground and Label.foreground receive the panel foreground. Button.background receives the button background. Button.foreground receives the button foreground. TextField.background receives the field background. TextField.foreground and TextField.caretForeground receive the field foreground. PasswordField.background receives the field background. PasswordField.foreground and PasswordField.caretForeground receive the field foreground. ComboBox.background receives the field background. ComboBox.foreground receives the field foreground. CheckBox.background receives the panel background. CheckBox.foreground receives the panel foreground. Spinner.background receives the field background. // @aa-sdd PK-1151 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md Spinner.foreground receives the field foreground. // @aa-sdd PK-999 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md OptionPane.background receives the panel background. OptionPane.messageForeground and OptionPane.foreground receive the panel foreground. OptionPane.buttonForeground receives the panel foreground. PopupMenu.background receives the panel background. PopupMenu.foreground receives the menu foreground. Menu.background and MenuItem.background receive the panel background. Menu.foreground and MenuItem.foreground receive the menu foreground. SplitPane.background receives the split background. ScrollBar.background receives the panel background. The key control receives the panel background. The key text receives the field foreground. The key nimbusBase receives the panel background. The key nimbusFocus receives the button background. SplitPane.border becomes a raised bevel using the highlight and the shadow. SplitPaneDivider.border becomes an empty border of zero on every side. installQuietEdges() runs next. seatButtonHover() runs last.

    • applyPanel

      public void applyPanel(JPanel panel)
      The applyPanel method paints a panel. The background is the panel background. The foreground is the panel foreground. The panel is opaque.
      Parameters:
      panel - The panel to paint.

    • applyLabel

      public void applyLabel(JLabel label)
      The applyLabel method paints a label. The background is the panel background. The foreground is the panel foreground. The label is not opaque.
      Parameters:
      label - The label to paint.

    • applyPopup

      public void applyPopup(JPopupMenu menu)
      The applyPopup method paints a context menu. A null menu returns immediately. The menu is opaque. The background is the panel background. The foreground is the menu foreground. The border is a line in the button background. The painter is a basic popup painter. paintMenuComponent(Component) then paints every child.
      Parameters:
      menu - The menu to paint.

    • applyTextField

      public void applyTextField(JTextField field)
      The applyTextField method paints a text field. The background is the field background. The foreground, the caret, and the selected text use the field colors. The selection color is the button background. The selected text color is the button foreground. The border is a button-background line around an empty inset of three, four, three, and four. The field is opaque.
      Parameters:
      field - The field to paint.

    • applyPasswordField

      public void applyPasswordField(JPasswordField field)
      The applyPasswordField method paints a password field. The field is passed to applyTextField(JTextField).
      Parameters:
      field - The password field to paint.

    • applyButton

      Parameters:
      button - The button to paint.

    • applyFlatButtonBorder

      public void applyFlatButtonBorder(AbstractButton button)
      The applyFlatButtonBorder method sets the flat button border. The outer line uses the field background. The inner empty border is four, ten, four, and ten.
      Parameters:
      button - The button whose border is replaced.

    • applyScrollPane

      public void applyScrollPane(JScrollPane pane)
      The applyScrollPane method arms the overlay scroll bars. // @aa-sdd PK-1114 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md AppleScrollBar.install(JScrollPane) receives the pane.
      Parameters:
      pane - The scroll pane.

    • applyCanvasScroll

      public void applyCanvasScroll(JScrollPane pane)
      The applyCanvasScroll method paints the scroll pane under the canvas tab. A null pane returns immediately. applyScrollPane(JScrollPane) arms the overlay bars. The pane background is the panel background. The border is a raised bevel. The lit edge is the bevel highlight. The dark edge is the bevel shadow. The viewport border is removed.
      Parameters:
      pane - The scroll pane under the canvas tab.

    • applyCheckBox

      public void applyCheckBox(JCheckBox checkBox)
      The applyCheckBox method paints a check box. The background is the panel background. The foreground is the panel foreground. The box is opaque. The focus ring is not painted. One SshClientTheme.SapphireCheck is used for the normal, selected, rollover, pressed, and disabled icons.
      Parameters:
      checkBox - The check box to paint.

    • applyMenuBar

      public void applyMenuBar(JMenuBar bar)
      The applyMenuBar method paints the window menu. A null bar returns immediately. The bar is opaque. The background is the panel background. Each menu item is not opaque. Each menu item uses the menu foreground. seatMenuHover(JMenuItem) installs the grey hover tab on each menu item. A child that is not a menu item is skipped.
      Parameters:
      bar - The menu bar.

    • applyComboBox

      public void applyComboBox(JComboBox<?> comboBox)
      The applyComboBox method paints a combo box. The background is the field background. The foreground is the field foreground. The combo box is opaque. seatComboArrow(JComboBox) replaces the arrow.
      Parameters:
      comboBox - The combo box to paint.

    • applySplitPane

      public void applySplitPane(JSplitPane splitPane)
      The applySplitPane method paints a split pane. The background is the split background. The pane is opaque. The border is removed. One-touch expansion is turned on. The left and right components are remembered. The painter becomes a SshClientTheme.DarkSplitUi. A non-null left component is put back. A non-null right component is put back. One-touch expansion is turned on again. The divider size becomes DIVIDER_SIZE.
      Parameters:
      splitPane - The split pane to paint.

    • installPlateTabs

      public void installPlateTabs(JTabbedPane tabs)
      The installPlateTabs method installs the plate tab painter. The painter is a SshClientTheme.PlateTabUi. The strip is opaque. The background is red 13, green 13, blue 13. The border is removed.
      Parameters:
      tabs - The product tabs or the canvas tabs.

    • installPlateButton

      public void installPlateButton(JButton button, boolean selected)
      The installPlateButton method paints a folded SSH or Aetheris button. The property aetheris.plate.selected stores the selected flag. // @aa-sdd PK-1000 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md The button is not opaque. // @aa-sdd PK-999 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md The content area is not filled by the stock painter. The focus ring is not painted. The border is an empty border of two, eight, two, and eight. Rollover is enabled. A button that is not already using SshClientTheme.PlateButtonUi receives that painter. A button that already uses it is repainted.
      Parameters:
      button - The folded product button.
      selected - True when this button matches the selected tab.
